```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| echo: true
snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)
snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

fetch_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {
  response <- tryCatch(
    request(address) |>
      req_timeout(120) |>
      req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
      req_perform() |>
      resp_check_status(),
    error = \(e) {
      warning(
        "Could not retrieve the ", snapshot_year,
        " Wayback capture: ", conditionMessage(e)
      )
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(response)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  page <- resp_body_html(response)
  movies <- page |>
    html_table() |>
    pluck(1) |>
    select(`Rank & Title`, `IMDb Rating`) |>
    mutate(`Rank & Title` = str_squish(`Rank & Title`)) |>
    extract(
      `Rank & Title`,
      into = c("rank", "title", "year"),
      regex = "^(\\d+)\\.\\s*(.*?)\\s*\\((\\d{4})\\)$",
      convert = TRUE
    )
  number <- page |>
    html_elements("td.ratingColumn strong") |>
    html_attr("title") |>
    str_extract("[[:digit:],]+(?= votes)") |>
    str_remove_all(",") |>
    as.numeric()

  movies |>
    transmute(
      snap_year = snapshot_year,
      rank,
      title,
      year,
      rating = `IMDb Rating`,
      number
    )
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snapshot_urls, snapshot_years, fetch_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank) |>
  drop_na(`2015`, `2022`) |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = paste0(floor(year / 10) * 10, "s"),
    rank_change = abs(`2015` - `2022`),
    rank_movement = `2015` - `2022`
  )

rank_changes |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change)) |>
  arrange(as.integer(str_remove(release_decade, "s")))
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_movement), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      average_rank_change > 0 ~ "Rank rose",
      average_rank_change < 0 ~ "Rank fell",
      TRUE ~ "No net change"
    ),
    release_decade = fct_reorder(
      release_decade,
      as.integer(str_remove(release_decade, "s"))
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = average_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Rank fell" = "#D55E00",
      "Rank rose" = "#0072B2",
      "No net change" = "#8C8C8C"
    ),
    name = "Direction"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "From 2015 to 2022; positive values indicate films moved up the rankings.",
    x = "Average rank movement (places)",
    y = "Release decade",
    caption = paste(
      "Sample size:",
      nrow(rank_changes),
      "films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  distinct(title, year, snap_year) |>
  count(title, year, name = "snapshot_count") |>
  count(snapshot_count, name = "film_count") |>
  arrange(snapshot_count)
```
